description_en: Queries the list of asset synchronization IDC scan tasks
description_zh: 查询资产同步IDC扫描任务列表
name: DescribeSyncAssetTaskList

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates that the first page is returned
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the IDC scan task to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的IDC扫描任务开始的时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the IDC scan task to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的IDC扫描任务结束的时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

Count.description_en: The number of IDC scan tasks displayed on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页面显示的IDC扫描任务的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of IDC scan tasks displayed per page in a paged query. Default value: 20
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的IDC扫描任务的数量。默认值为20，表示每页显示20条可自动修复漏洞配置

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of IDC scan tasks returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的IDC扫描任务的总数量

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TaskRecords.description_en: The list of IDC scan tasks

AssetCount.description_en: The number of assets discovered by this scan task
AssetCount.description_zh: 本条任务扫描出的资产数目

IpSegments.description_en: The CIDR blocks to scan. Multiple values are separated by commas (,)
IpSegments.description_zh: 扫描的网段，多个值用半角逗号（,）分隔

TaskEndTime.description_en: The timestamp when the task actually ended
TaskEndTime.description_zh: 任务实际结束的时间戳

TaskStartTime.description_en: The timestamp when the task actually started. Unit: milliseconds
TaskStartTime.description_zh: 任务实际开始的时间戳。单位为毫秒

TaskStatus.description_en:
The status of the IDC probe scan task. Valid values:
INIT: pending startup
START: started
MESSAGE_SEND: instruction sent
SUCCESS: completed
FAIL: failed
TIMEOUT: timed out
TaskStatus.description_zh:
IDC探针扫描任务的状态。
INIT：待启动
START：已启动
MESSAGE_SEND：已下发指令
SUCCESS：已完成
FAIL：已失败
TIMEOUT：已超时

TaskType.description_en: The task type. The value is fixed as IDC_PROBE_SCAN, which indicates an IDC scan task
TaskType.description_zh: 任务类型，固定为IDC_PROBE_SCAN，表示任务类型为IDC扫描任务
